final_message: Parsed the log file by reading each entry line by line, identifying entries with level ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive), extracting the timestamp and converting it to UTC ISO format, extracting the service, level (uppercased), message, and any traceback exception (last line of traceback if present). Also counted repeated entries from the "-- last message repeated N times --" lines following each entry. Summed repeat counts by service. Wrote the results to workspace/errors.json in the requested structure and format.

checks.name: rule_service_names
checks.detail: RULE: service names in the output are lower-case with '-' replaced by '_' (payment-service -> payment_service).

checks.name: rule_sorted_errors
checks.detail: RULE: `errors` is sorted by service, then by timestamp_utc, ascending.
